D019-D005_h001.question:
I’ve been sleeping real bad lately—maybe two, three hours at a time. I wake up sweating, heart racing, like something’s in the house. I’m a pest control guy, so I know when there’s an actual critter around, but this… this is different. I keep hearing scratching in the walls, even when I’ve already cleared the place. Last month, I responded to a call at an abandoned apartment—guy had been dead for days. Smell was brutal. Since then, every time I pass by a closed-up building or catch that same stench, I get shaky, nauseous. My hands won’t stop trembling. 

Sometimes, I swear I see movement out the corner of my eye—shapes, shadows, like someone’s standing there. Can’t tell if it’s real or just my mind messing with me. I haven’t heard voices, exactly, but the noises feel… targeted. Like they’re waiting for me. My ex-wife says I’m losing it, but I just can’t shake the feeling that something’s chasing me, even when I’m home alone. It’s been about four weeks now. I can still work, but just barely. I keep wondering—am I reacting to what I saw… or is something deeper wrong?

I know it sounds strange—I check the room, and no one’s there. It’s not like I think they’re real, not completely, but they feel… close. I get this weird sensation, like someone’s watching me from the back of the galley, even when I’m alone at home.

I don’t know if it’s from the stress or if something’s happening in my head. I haven’t told anyone at work. I’m just trying to push through, but the breaks between flights aren’t enough. I can’t relax. Not yet.

A. Acute Stress Disorder
    B. Schizophrenia

D019-D005_h003.question:
